nodes.description: Private owner address stored by Ownable; written by _setOwner and renounceOwnership, read by owner().
Sale start timestamp in SaleControl, defaulted to __SALE_NEVER_STARTS; compared against block.timestamp in saleStarted().
Price per token in wei set in the constructor and used in the mint value check.
Maximum number of tokens claimable per address, updatable by the owner and used in the mint cap check.
Merkle root of the whitelist, set in the constructor and updatable by the owner.
Mapping(address => uint256) tracking how many tokens each address has claimed; updated after the external mint call.
Immutable IMetaverseNFT reference used for the extension permission check and the external mintExternal call.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
View function returning the current _owner.
onlyOwner function that validates newOwner and calls _setOwner.
Private setter writing _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
onlyOwner function overwriting startTimestamp with a caller-supplied value.
onlyOwner function setting startTimestamp = block.timestamp.
onlyOwner function setting startTimestamp = __SALE_NEVER_STARTS.
View function returning block.timestamp >= startTimestamp.
Payable whitelisted mint: checks the merkle proof and caps, performs the external nft.mintExternal value call, then increments claimedByAddress (effects after interaction).
Pure helper hashing the receiver into a leaf and verifying it against the merkle root.
onlyOwner function overwriting maxPerAddress.
onlyOwner function overwriting whitelistRoot.
NFTExtension internal view check that this contract is an allowed extension of nft.
Caller-controlled address, used as the merkle leaf receiver, the claimedByAddress key and the mint recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for sale start and sale status.
External value-bearing call into the NFT contract executed before claimedByAddress is updated.
Per-address claim counter increment performed after the external call.
Arithmetic payment check multiplying user-controlled nTokens by price.
Arithmetic cap check adding user-controlled nTokens to the stored claim count.
Constructor calling stopSale() and initializing price, maxPerAddress and whitelistRoot.
onlyOwner function calling _setOwner(address(0)).
User-supplied token quantity parameter of mint.
User-supplied merkle proof array parameter of mint.
Merkle root parameter of isWhitelisted.
Receiver address parameter of isWhitelisted.
Merkle proof array parameter of isWhitelisted.
Local leaf hash computed from the receiver address.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
New sale start timestamp parameter of updateStartTimestamp.
Whitelist root constructor parameter.
Token price constructor parameter.
Per-address claim cap constructor parameter.
New per-address cap parameter of updateMaxPerAddress.
New whitelist root parameter of updateWhitelistRoot.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller of mint and drives the whole whitelist/claim flow.
msg.sender indexes the claimedByAddress mapping read and written during mint.
mint executes the external value call to nft.mintExternal.
The immutable nft state variable is the target of the external mintExternal call.
The claim counter update runs only after the external call returns, violating checks-effects-interactions.
External call completes before claimedByAddress is mutated, allowing stale state on re-entry.
The external call into the NFT contract can re-enter mint before claimedByAddress is updated.
User-controlled nTokens parameter is consumed by mint.
nTokens is forwarded as the amount argument of the external mintExternal call.
nTokens is multiplied by price in the payment requirement.
price state variable participates in the nTokens * price multiplication.
nTokens is added to the stored claim count in the cap check.
claimedByAddress value is read in the maxPerAddress cap check.
maxPerAddress is the bound of the claim cap comparison.
nTokens is added to claimedByAddress[msg.sender].
claimedByAddress is the storage slot mutated by the unchecked-style increment.
startSale derives the sale start from the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
saleStarted compares block.timestamp against the stored start timestamp (timestamp dependency).
saleStarted reads startTimestamp state variable for the time comparison.
User-supplied merkle proof parameter flows into the mint control flow.
mint invokes the isWhitelisted helper to gate the mint.
The isWhitelisted boolean result controls whether mint proceeds.
msg.sender is passed as the receiver hashed into the merkle leaf.
whitelistRoot state variable is supplied as the merkle root.
root parameter is used in the merkle proof verification.
receiver parameter is hashed to build the leaf.
proof parameter is iterated over in the merkle verification.
Locally computed leaf hash is returned for the whitelist result.
newOwner parameter determines who gains ownership.
transferOwnership delegates the state change to _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
owner() returns the stored _owner value.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, the untrusted caller identity.
_startTimestamp parameter is written into sale configuration.
updateStartTimestamp overwrites the startTimestamp state variable.
startSale writes startTimestamp from block.timestamp.
stopSale resets startTimestamp to the never-starts sentinel.
The constructor calls stopSale() to disable sales initially.
Constructor assigns the _whitelistRoot parameter to whitelistRoot.
Constructor assigns the _price parameter to price.
Constructor assigns the _maxPerAddress parameter to maxPerAddress.
_whitelistRoot parameter is consumed by the constructor.
_price parameter is consumed by the constructor.
_maxPerAddress parameter is consumed by the constructor.
updateMaxPerAddress overwrites the per-address claim cap.
updateWhitelistRoot overwrites the merkle whitelist root.
mint calls super.beforeMint() to verify extension authorization.
beforeMint reads the nft state variable for the isExtensionAllowed check.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.

normalization_plan.reason: The nTokens parameter only exists to feed the mint function's arithmetic checks and external call, so it is normalized into the mint core function.
The proof parameter is only routed by mint into isWhitelisted and carries no independent semantics, so it merges into mint.
The root parameter is a direct input of the isWhitelisted verification function.
The receiver parameter is hashed inside isWhitelisted to build the merkle leaf.
The proof parameter is iterated only inside isWhitelisted.
The leaf local variable is computed and consumed exclusively within isWhitelisted.
newOwner is the sole argument of transferOwnership and is checked and forwarded there.
_startTimestamp is the only argument written to startTimestamp by updateStartTimestamp.
The constructor parameter initializes whitelistRoot directly.
The constructor parameter initializes price directly.
The constructor parameter initializes maxPerAddress directly.
The parameter is assigned to maxPerAddress inside updateMaxPerAddress only.
The parameter is assigned to whitelistRoot inside updateWhitelistRoot only.
